x-note: v2.2 increment 2, third evolution of a rename: the destructive contract. Applies after parcels-retire-label.json was deployed and verified again with the retired generation. It drops `reference` and `weight_kg` with their sync triggers and functions, RESTRICT, in one transaction, only when the sixteen preconditions hold; it needs `--authorize-contract` and `--confirm-irreversible "drop shipments.reference, shipments.weight_kg"` on the command line. `no_destructive_schema_change` is left out on purpose. The downgrade recreates the columns from the new ones' current values (offline); the dropped content is not recoverable from the database.
